name: 将数据从暂存区迁移至 SAP S/4HANA (2Q2)
name_en: Data Migration to SAP S/4HANA from Staging (2Q2)
description_en_html:
Overview

SAP S/4HANA customers can use the included SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition migration cockpit to migrate data.

If the customer chooses to use the Migrate Data Using Staging Tables approach, the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition migration cockpit creates staging tables for the migration objects that are relevant for your project and migrates data from these staging tables to the target SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system.

If you use the Local SAP S/4HANA Database Schema option, the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition migration cockpit generates the staging tables in the local ABAP schema of the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system. We recommend using this option if you want to populate the staging tables using the template files provided by SAP.

If you use the Remote SAP HANA Database Schema option, you specify the relevant connection to a remote SAP HANA system. The SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition migration cockpit generates the staging tables there.

Key Process Flow

  • Create a project
  • Select the migration objects that are relevant for your migration project
  • Fill the staging tables with data using SAP or third-party ETL tools or by using the template files provided by SAP
  • Process any open mapping tasks to ensure correct source data mapping
  • Simulate the migration of data
  • Rework data and repeat mapping tasks (if required)
  • Repeat the simulation process (if required)
  • Migrate the data to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition

Business Benefits

  • Deliver migration projects on time and within budget
  • Provide trusted data to users
  • Increase data load performance by changing to table read rather than file upload
  • Ensure quality master data for your core business processes
  • Validate the data against specific customer business rules
  • Load data into your SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition system
description_zh_html:
概览

SAP S/4HANA 客户可以使用包含的 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 迁移主控室迁移数据。

如果客户选择使用使用暂存表迁移数据方法，SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 迁移主控室将为与项目相关的迁移对象创建暂存表，并将数据从这些暂存表迁移到目标 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统。

如果使用本地 SAP S/4HANA 数据库模式选项，SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 迁移主控室将在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统的本地 ABAP 模式中生成暂存表。如果要使用 SAP 提供的模板文件填充暂存表，建议使用此选项。

如果使用远程 SAP HANA 数据库模式选项，则指定到远程 SAP HANA 系统的相关连接。SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 迁移主控室在此处生成暂存表。

关键流程流

  • 创建项目
  • 选择与迁移项目相关的迁移对象。
  • 使用 SAP 或第三方 ETL 工具或使用 SAP 提供的模板文件在暂存表中填充数据
  • 处理所有未完成映射任务，以确保源数据映射正确
  • 模拟数据迁移
  • 返工数据并重复映射任务（如果需要）
  • 重复模拟流程（如果需要）
  • 将数据迁移到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition

业务优势

  • 在预算内按时交付迁移项目
  • 为用户提供可靠数据
  • 通过更改为表读取而不是文件上载，提高数据加载性能
  • 确保核心业务流程的质量主数据
  • 根据特定客户业务规则验证数据
  • 将数据加载到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 系统
